checks: Saved values extracted; saved range classification and mean-ratio arithmetic checked only.
limitations: Finite reference is shared by selection, MC budgeting and evaluation; not simultaneous truth bounds.
Finite 192-cohort empirical RMSE ranges are not population-RMSE confidence intervals.
Selection flags 192/192 are measured calibration diagnostics; independent BAR diagnostics are not collected.
Different hosts and unknown hardware/load prevent calibrated hardware speedup claims.
MC pool covers all eight conditions; BAR pools cover two conditions per case; phase clocks are not apportioned.
Both within is a threshold qualification, not equal achieved precision, minimum time-to-accuracy or coverage guarantee.
Main p=.03/.05 results do not evaluate low-noise independent timing.
